programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Alag
programme.desc: Tejas, an odd boy who grew up in a basement, is moved to a rehabilitation centre after his father's death. When he starts displaying psychic powers, a scientist abducts him for experimentation.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Falak
programme.desc: Ramnath, a watchman, is killed while stopping his corrupt bosses from committing a crime. Years later, his sons decide to exact revenge against his murderers.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Goonj

programme.title: Parinati
programme.desc: Ganesh, a potter living in a remote village of Rajasthan with his wife, Kurjan, and their son Laxman, is asked to make a choice for the sake of Laxman's bright future.

programme.title: Zubeidaa
programme.desc: Drama set in the 1950s, about an aspiring actress who marries a prince to become his second wife. Her rocky relationship with her husband and her decision to break free has fatal consequences.

programme.title: Star

programme.title: Haathon Ki Lakeeren
programme.desc: A dramatic story of the anguish & despair felt by a woman who is about to be separated from a child she adopted when the biological parents turn up on her doorstep demanding their child back.

programme.title: Sion y Chef
programme.desc: Mae'n ben-lwydd priodas ar Mama Polenta ac Alf ac mae Siôn wedi cynnig coginio cyri a reis, ond mae bochdew Mario wedi bod yn cnoi'r reis! Oh no! Mario's pet hamster has been at the rice!

programme.title: Cacamwnci
programme.desc: Mae Cacamwnci nôl gyda mwy o sgetsys dwl a doniol, a chymeriadau newydd sbon fel Clem Clocsio, Myrddin y Dewin a Vanessa drws nesa. Cacamwnci is back with more silly sketches!

programme.title: Octonots
programme.desc: Mae Harri yn gwarchod aligator bach ond pan fydd hwnnw'n dianc o'r Octofad, rhaid i Harri a gweddill yr Octonots ei achub. Harri adopts a baby alligator but it escapes!

programme.title: Byd Tad-cu
programme.desc: 'Beth yw llosgfynydd?' yw cwestiwn Gweni heddiw. Mae gan Tad-cu ateb dwl am Pegi'r Pengwin oedd eisiau bod yn gogydd byd-enwog! Gweni asks 'What is a volcano?' and Grandpa spins a tale.

programme.title: Blociau Rhif
programme.desc: Mae'n ddiwrnod glawog ar gyfer picnic, ond pan mae'r rhif Saith yn cyrraedd, mae'r Enfys yn ymddangos. It's a rainy day for a picnic,but when lucky number Seven appears,the rainbow appears.

programme.title: Crawc a'i Ffrindiau
programme.desc: Pan mae "Capten" Gwich yn gwahodd ei ffrindiau ar ei gwch mae'n mynnu taw fe yw'r bos - ond mae'n dysgu gwers bwysig. Ratty takes his friends on a boat trip and learns an important lesson.

programme.title: Bendibwmbwls
programme.desc: Mae Ben Dant ar antur newydd i ailgylchu - i droi sbwriel yn sbeshal a gwastraff yn gampwaith. Ben Dant joins the pupils of Ysgol Dyffryn Trannon, Trefeglwys to create a superb treasure.

programme.title: Twm Twrch
programme.desc: Mae'n ddiwrnod ralio yng Nghwmtwrch a mae Mishmosh yn brysur yn paratoi car Twm Twrch i'w alluogi i ennill drwy dwyll. It's rally day in Cwmtwrch and Mishmosh is preparing Twm Twrch's car.

programme.title: Ne-wff-ion
programme.desc: Mae lladrad wedi bod mewn siop cigydd yng Nghaerdydd, mae Mabli yno i ddod a'r diweddaraf i ni. We vist Ysgol y Dderi to learn about where the vegetables in their school lunch comes from.

programme.title: Sam Tan
programme.desc: Mae Joe wedi dyfeisio ci robotig newydd o'r enw'r Firedog 2000 i helpu mewn sefyllfaoedd brys. Joe has invented a new robotic dog called the Firedog 2000 to help in emergency situations.

programme.title: Ahoi!
programme.desc: A fydd criw o forladron bach Ysgol Gwaun Cae Gurwen yn llwyddo i helpu Ben Dant a Cadi i drechu Capten Cnec? Ben Dant and Cadi need help from the little pirates of Ysgol Gwaun Cae Gurwen.

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Mae annwyd ar Cen Twyn felly mae'r Harbwr Feistr eisiau i bawb dynnu at ei gilydd i orffen eu gwaith yn gyflym i Cen gael gorffwys. Heti the Hovercract leads Twt astray when Cen has a cold.

programme.title: Ein Byd Bach...
programme.desc: Yn y bennod yma byddwn yn dysgu am sut mae'r enfys yn ffurfio, be sy'n neud y gwair yn wyrdd, am fwydydd lliwgar, a llawer mwy. We learn about the 'Aurora Borealis' - the Northern Lights.

programme.title: Awyr Iach
programme.desc: Mae Meleri yn cwrdd a theulu sy'n mwynhau Geocashio, ac mae Jeno a'i theulu yn ymweld a Bwlch Nant yr Arian. Today, Huw joins a group of children keeping the village of Llanberis tidy.

programme.title: Olobobs
programme.desc: Mae Palu Soch yn helpu Dino ddod o hyd i gartref i'r holl 'stwff' sy'n creu llanast yn ei ogof. Diggy Piggy helps Deeno to find a home for all the 'stuff' he has filling up his den.

programme.title: Og y Draenog Hapus
programme.desc: Mae Og a'i ffrindiau'n teimlo'n gyffrous iawn wrth ddisgwyl i lindysen droi'n bili pala. Og and his friends feel very excited waiting for a caterpillar to turn into a butterfly.

programme.title: Dreigiau Cadi
programme.desc: Ar ôl cael ei fesur, mae Bledd yn deffro i ddarganfod efallai ei fod wedi tyfu gormod. After being measured, Bledd wakes up to discover he may have grown too much.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Heddiw, mae gan Pablo ddau fochyn coed i daro yn erbyn pethau, i weld sut mae'r pethau yna'n swnio. Today, Pablo has two pinecones for tapping, which turn out to be explorers!

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae hi'n argyfwng ar Sioned Siop - does dim bara wedi cyrraedd ac mae'r gwersyllwyr angen brecwast. It's an emergency for Sioned Siop - no bread has arrived, and the campers need breakfast.

programme.title: Brethyn a Fflwff

programme.title: Sion y Chef
programme.desc: Mae Sinema Sbonc yn digwydd ar sgwâr Pentre Braf, ond mae peiriant gwneud popgorn Jac Jôs yn difa'r sgrîn, a'r hwyl ar ben - am y tro. Jac Jôs' popcorn maker ruins the kids' favourite film!

programme.title: Miss MacTaggart Won't Lie Down
programme.desc: 1966. Comedy. Directed by Francis A Searle. Stars Barbara Mullen and Eric Woodburn. A spinster has been proclaimed dead - but is very much alive... [S]

programme.title: Rock You Sinners
programme.desc: 1957. Musical. A disc-jockey gets his own TV show and becomes a star. Starring Jackie Collins and featuring many musical acts of the 50's. [S]

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. Invitation To Limbo. Crime series produced by Aaron Spelling & stars Anne Francis. An electronics firm hires Honey to find an industrial spy who has been leaking company secrets.

programme.title: The Adventures of Jim Bowie
programme.desc: Broomstick Wedding. 1956. Stars Scott Forbes & Mike Connors. An angry farmer mistakenly believes that Jim is the man who 'dishonoured' his daughter and has to right his wrong by marrying her. [S]

programme.title: The More the Merrier
programme.desc: 1943. Romantic Comedy. Directed by George Stevens. Stars Jean Arthur, Joel McCrea & Charles Coburn. During the wartime housing shortage, a woman sublets half her apartment to two bachelors. [S]

programme.title: Do You Know This Voice?
programme.desc: 1964. Drama. Directed by Frank Nesbitt. Stars Dan Duryea, Isa Miranda, Gwen Watford & Peter Madden. In this great murder mystery, the only clue to the killer's identity is his shoes! [S]

programme.title: Forbidden
programme.desc: 1949. Drama. Directed by George King. Stars Douglass Montgomery, Hazel Court & Patricia Burke. An ex-serviceman plans to escape his faithless wife. [S]

programme.title: Suspected Person
programme.desc: 1942. Drama. Director: Lawrence Huntington. Stars Clifford Evans, Patricia Roc, David Farrar, Robert Beatty, William Hartnell. Two bank robbers try to find their partner, who fled to London. [S]

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Secret Death. 1958. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. When his wife is captured by Gessler's troops and sentenced to death, Tell offers himself in exchange. [S]

programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Director Roy Ward Baker. Stars Hardy Kruger, Colin Gordon & Michael Goodliffe. A German flight officer is shot down over England and makes numerous attempts to escape to fight again. [S]

programme.title: La Mariee est Trop Belle
programme.desc: 1956. Drama. Director: Pierre Gaspard-Huit. Stars Brigitte Bardot, Micheline Presle & Louis Jourdan. A country girl is discovered by a Paris magazine and becomes a top model. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life It's Odds on the Fish
programme.desc: 1968. A look into the art of angling, with a consideration for the problems of ensuring that angling continues as a form of sport and relaxation.

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Dutchman's Reef. 1961. Stars Peter Graves, Anthony Wickert & Leonard Teale. Mrs. Culbert summons Cobb to search for her missing son but he is not interested until they come to an agreement. [S]

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Terbuf Affair. 1964. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Leo G. Carroll. Solo and Kuryakin are spending some time off in Rome when Solo meets an old flame who is in need of help. [S]

programme.title: Gideon's Way
programme.desc: The Nightlifers. Stars Derek Fowlds, John Gregson, Alexander Davion and Daphne Anderson. A group of rich young people go from endless parties aboard a houseboat to violent crimes in the city. [S]

programme.title: Murders In...
programme.desc: Murders in Collioure - Meurtres à Collioure. 2015. Director: Bruno Garcia. Stars Stéphane Freiss & Héléna Noguerra. A young woman is found murdered echoing a local medieval legend of a witch. [S]

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: A cursed night is in store for all Cellar Dwellers, as Caroline Munro invites us into the world of female vampires, with The World of Hammer episode Vamp. [S]

programme.title: The World of Hammer
programme.desc: Vamp. 1994. Narrated by Oliver Reed. A look at Hammer's depiction of female vampires, which was consistently groundbreaking and controversial, with the fine line trodden between desire and evil. [S]

programme.title: The Haunting of Julia
